goal: Choose a trustworthy shared marker and interaction architecture for all VII discovery maps.

facts.claim: The current shared map already supports Leaflet, clustering, overlapping-marker expansion and selected cards.
facts.evidence: app/components/listing-map.tsx in the active release checkout.

facts.claim: Vacation, event, discovery and trail adapters currently derive marker labels differently.
facts.evidence: ListingMap, DiscoveryMap and TrailMap in app/components/listing-map.tsx.

facts.claim: VII product truth forbids deriving an undated opening price from an arbitrary availability probe.
Airbnb documents map pan/zoom discovery and Booking documents price and sorting transparency.
facts.evidence: Airbnb help articles 252 and 39; Booking How We Work.

assumptions.claim: A shared typed marker-value resolver can consume every current adapter without changing supplier schemas.
assumptions.evidence_or_test: Compile-time adapter tests and fixture comparisons will support or disprove it.

assumptions.claim: The reported missing selected cards are caused by responsive visibility/state rules rather than Leaflet selection failure.
assumptions.evidence_or_test: Reproduce each world at the failing viewport and inspect DOM, body flags and click transitions before editing.

risks.risk: Displaying a price from unverified free text misleads users.
risks.mitigation: Use only price fields already accepted by the corresponding list result and encode missing price explicitly.
risks.verification: Marker/list parity fixtures plus live samples per world.

risks.risk: A shared CSS change hides map controls in another viewport or world.
risks.mitigation: Replace body-coupled visibility with component state and run a six-world three-viewport matrix.

risks.risk: Viewport filtering silently removes eligible results or changes ranking.
risks.mitigation: Keep viewport results pending until explicit action and preserve the accepted source pool.
risks.verification: ID/count snapshots before pan, after pan and after applying viewport search.

risks.mitigation: Keep Leaflet lazy, reuse one card, avoid eager media and measure interaction/load budgets.
risks.verification: Bundle/build comparison and browser timing observations.

alternatives.option: Keep generic pins in every non-vacation world.
alternatives.tradeoff: Low implementation risk but fails cross-world comparison and the explicit user request.

alternatives.option: Render an amount parsed from any text containing a number.
alternatives.tradeoff: Appears comprehensive but can invent misleading prices, dates or capacities and is rejected.

alternatives.option: Build separate map implementations per world.
alternatives.tradeoff: Allows local tuning but multiplies regressions and contradicts the shared-platform objective.

alternatives.option: Use one shared typed marker-value contract with verified price, semantic fallback and shared responsive shell.
alternatives.tradeoff: Requires adapter inventory and migration but centralizes truth, QA and future evolution; selected.

acceptance_checks.check: Verified-price markers match list cards in every price-bearing world.
acceptance_checks.evidence_or_reason: Requires source tracing and automated fixtures.

acceptance_checks.check: Missing-price entities remain useful and never show invented amounts.
Map/list and selected marker/card state stay synchronized across viewports.
Production serves the exact tested release with rollback recorded.

natural_destination: The six public VII map-enabled discovery routes on vii.spaplus.co.
affected_family: All map-enabled worlds, four languages, shared map/list controls, marker values, selected-place cards, loading/error states and responsive layouts.
authorization_boundary: Proceed with source, tests and one verified publication. Do not invent or modify supplier data and do not replace the approved place-detail snapshot consent model.
remaining_blockers: Exact verified price provenance must be proven for each non-vacation adapter before its marker may show an amount.
